name: cortex-dl
description: Cortex DL - Advanced Video and Audio Downloader
author: Cortex Team

scripts.predev: node scripts/ensure-electron.cjs && npm run engines:stage && npm run build:manifest
scripts.test:unit: node --test --test-name-pattern="^(analysis |batch analysis |optional JSON |thumbnail streams |cookie validation |codec decisions |renderer stale |IPC progressive |direct analysis |last analysis |Visual Trim validates|Visual Trim suppresses|fast Pause|retry backoff|recovery never|active delete|Direct backend progress|unknown-length progress|YouTube video/audio progress|all shared media formats|yt-dlp continuation|Pause All|SQLite progress|resume broadcasts|terminal IPC|yt-dlp repeated|progress preserves|progress replaces)" tests/coreV2.test.cjs tests/reliability.test.cjs tests/trimPreview.test.cjs tests/analysisPerformance.test.cjs && node --test tests/productionHardening.test.cjs
scripts.test:integration: node --test tests/coreV2.test.cjs tests/reliability.test.cjs tests/mediaLifecycle.test.cjs tests/trimPreview.test.cjs tests/analysisPerformance.test.cjs
scripts.build:candidate: npm run version:verify && node scripts/third-party-notices.cjs && npm run build:manifest && tsc && vite build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.release:build: node scripts/verify-release.cjs --release && npm run build:candidate && node scripts/verify-release.cjs --release --artifacts
